criterion: 用到的舊 SPEC 及必要設計依賴可轉換新格式，ID／語意／來源／回答／證據狀態與引用可追溯；Markdown 成為目前來源，生成 manifest 一致。可證明純格式遷移沿用原授權，未知歷史不被偽造，無關歷史不被改寫。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Selected legacy SPEC and required manifest migrate automatically with raw-byte/projection proofs, IDs, answers, evidence and original authorization preserved. Dependencies are validated against the repository SPEC inventory; unrelated history is retained.
